metadata.title: Clicked like a confused squirrel and somehow snatched that 1 clueless soul? Valorant logic is wild
metadata.description:
Just mashed buttons like my mouse had a mind of its own.
Enemy probably confused if I’m hacker or just lucky.
Did NOT deserve that one but hey, chaos favors me today.
If your aim’s a beautiful disaster, you’ll feel this.

Hit like if your aim is more accident than skill!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
